title: AGENTS.md — planscanR.screen orientation
text: config-agnostic toolkit screening tibble text records topic relevance. Four layers, independently usable: Embedding relevance — multilingual cosine similarity topic phrases record’s text (R/relevance_model.R, MiniLM backend R/relevance_minilm.R). Zero-shot classification — per-record probabilities candidate labels via local HuggingFace NLI pipeline (R/classify_zeroshot.R, driver R/classify_assessments.R). Keyword lexicon — transparent multilingual substring count layer (R/score_keywords.R). Learned selection — tidymodels model learns keep/drop decision human review labels three signals (R/select_features.R, R/select_learner.R, R/train_selection.R, R/select_learning_curve.R). built planscanR family (environmental-assessment records) works tibble carrying country, title, summary (, selection model used, document_id plus scored columns). brings Python toolchain (via reticulate) leaf planscanR fetcher deliberately avoids.

title: Scoring records by topic relevance
text: Two complementary signals layer top cosine score. take vocabulary explicit argument — framework ships project defaults, define candidate labels keyword terms :
code: # Zero-shot classification against a labelled set of candidate classes. Names # are stable slugs (used as column suffixes); values are the hypotheses fed to # the model. Include explicit negative classes to catch look-alikes. labels <- c(   wind  = "wind energy project",   solar = "solar energy project",   other = "not about renewable energy" ) records <- classify_assessments(records, labels = labels)  # A transparent lexical (substring) count over a multilingual lexicon: a named # list of term vectors, one per topic. lexicon <- list(   wind  = c("wind", "turbine", "windpark", "windmolen"),   solar = c("solar", "zonne", "photovolta", "pv") ) records <- score_keywords(records, lexicon = lexicon)

title: planscanR.screen 0.0.0.9000
text: Initial release standalone package. scoring, classification, selection layers extracted planscanR fetching screening split separate packages: pure-R fetcher (planscanR) general-purpose screening framework. Embedding relevance. score_records() / score_assessments() score records one topics multilingual cosine similarity pluggable embedding_model(); built-backend embedding_model_minilm() (sentence-transformers MiniLM via reticulate). Records embedded per call, extra topics essentially free. Zero-shot classification. classify_assessments() assigns per-record label probabilities pluggable classifier(); built-classify_model_zeroshot() runs local multilingual NLI pipeline device auto-detection GPU batching, persists batch interrupted run resumable. Keyword lexicon. score_keywords() adds transparent multilingual substring-count signal caller-supplied lexicon. Learned selection. train_selection_model() / predict_selection() learn keep/drop decision human review labels three signals, pluggable tidymodels selection_learner() (default logistic regression). Metrics honest --fold (k-fold CV); selection_learning_curve() reports held-performance label pool grows. tidymodels glue optional dependency. Config-agnostic design. project-specific topics, labels, keyword lists ship — classify_assessments(labels=), score_keywords(lexicon=), selection-feature functions take vocabulary required arguments. Reads writes scores planscanR sidecar cache, screening results survive across sessions visible planscanR::index_cache().
